description: Runs a coding agent (Pi Durable) on a repository checkout in an isolated sandbox. Changes go to a branch named agent/<taskId> and a pull request; merge and deploy stay with humans.

capabilities.name: Coding agent
capabilities.description: Give an instruction and a repository (url + ref). The agent works in its own checkout, then the service pushes branch agent/<taskId> and opens a pull request. A budget (maxTokens, maxMinutes) is required: a job without one is rejected. Optional agentKey continues an earlier conversation on the same repository. The agent may ask the requester for approval before risky commands (the task shows input_required; answer with {approved: true|false, reason?}).

agentKey.description: stable key that selects the conversation; default: repository + the task's conversation

model.description: optional model for a new conversation; must be enabled on the agent (PI_ALLOWED_MODELS), otherwise the task fails with model_not_allowed. Default: the agent's own model.
